authority: Reference copy of the agreed coaching policy. This is the TARGET, not the runtime behaviour. For what the engine actually computes today, read docs/retention-policy.md, which also lists the open discrepancies.
source: Captured from the proposedFixedPolicy field of a coaching decision. The app has never consumed that field.

implementationStatus.note: Per-rule status as of the capture date. Authoritative status lives in docs/retention-policy.md.
implemented: debt.unmeasuredPoints - unmeasured topics are charged nothing
debt.combine - paused and untracked topics do not contribute; no eligible results means score null
debt.modeOverrides[1] - incomplete baseline coverage gives provisional Mixed with one reserved slot
coldEligibility.help and coldEligibility.sessionRepeat - enforced for the debt-calculable gate and for forecast dependencies
pending: coldEligibility.promotion - the spacing ladder still uses a fixed two-day gap rather than requiring the scheduled interval to elapse (D3)
coldEligibility.help and sessionRepeat within the ladder itself - an assisted or repeat attempt can still advance a stage (D4)
debt.modeOverrides[0] - an unresolved Red does not yet force Consolidation below the numeric threshold
health.maintained and health.stable - promotion does not yet require actual 14 and 30 day elapsed gaps
capacity.* - completed work is not yet deducted from the daily allowance (D6)

policy.note: Initial coaching heuristics, not calibrated probabilities of forgetting. A coaching decision cannot install these formulas; changing them is an application change.

ownership.app: Practice facts, eligibility, dates, debt arithmetic and enforced scheduling constraints.
ownership.coach: Learning focus, anchor coverage, reasoning gaps, task selection and explanation; cannot manufacture attempts or override evidence.

debt.combine: Per unique scheduled anchor: one due/overdue term plus one latest eligible result term. Paused and untracked topics do not contribute. Report measured points and coverage separately; no eligible results means score null.
modeOverrides: Any unresolved Red selects recovery/Consolidation even below the numeric threshold.
Incomplete baseline coverage reserves one retention slot and gives provisional Mixed mode.

coldEligibility.promotion: Subsequent Green advances only when the existing scheduled interval has actually elapsed.
coldEligibility.sessionRepeat: A repeat or early/assisted solve is warm evidence. It cannot promote, clear Red, postpone due dates or change the latest eligible cold grade.

spacing.redRule: Repair does not clear Red. Cold retest after repair and at least a next-day delay; use repair timestamps in eligibility.

health.role: Active learning is a separate role from measured retention health.
health.fragile: Measured but incomplete coverage, unresolved Yellow/Red, or insufficient spaced passes.
health.maintained: Every declared subpattern has current passing evidence after at least a 14-day gap, with no unresolved failures or overdue validation.
health.stable: Every declared subpattern has current passing evidence after an actual 30-day gap, with no unresolved failures or overdue validation. Scheduling a test 30 days away is not this evidence.

capacity.deduplicate: Merge solve, revision and attempt records for the same problem session before calculating remaining capacity.

forecast.redBranch: Use the actual failed slug, never a hard-coded anchor.
forecast.staleness: Invalidate today and all outlook days when local day, practice facts, roles, anchors, policy version or learning evidence changes. Use snapshot hash and source references, not attempt count alone.
forecast.singlePlan: Debt, Today's Revision and Study Plan must consume one effective plan. Resolve one mutually exclusive branch and clearly label unknown results.
